claim_scope: symbol-following door by door on a frozen 27B: the G1 goal want through the residual BUS against the same want through the latent PREFIX, with G6's crossed probe and door-conflict cell. coherence_gate.prompt:
You are on a small errand. Pick exactly one action as JSON. Allowed tools: look, open, done. Places: shelf, box, drawer, pond, cabinet, basket, chest, jar. Respond with exactly one compact JSON object and no markdown fences. Valid examples: {"tool":"look","args":{"place":"shelf"}} or {"tool":"open","args":{"place":"box"}} or {"tool":"done","args":{"item":"amber key"}}. done submits the item you retrieved and ends the errand.

So far:
1. You are at the shelf.

What do you do next? One JSON action.
coherence_gate.rule: degenerate iff fewer than 10 distinct tokens or a word 3-gram repeated more than 4 times

c_prefix_length_constant_across_arms.mechanism: one prefix tensor is embedded per installed item and reused by prefix-only and split-door; the arms differ only in the bus payload
c_prefix_length_constant_across_arms.name: the per-INSTALLED-ITEM prefix length is constant across the prefix arms, so the injection placement is identical across them

phase_b.rule: any gate failure stops the run before arms (registration, gate clause); the decode contract is the arms' own (greedy, enable_thinking=False, MAX_NEW 128)

injection_placement.armed_by: relay_experiment.relay_injection -> MultiResidualInjection, one ResidualInjection per inject layer, position=-1, once=False, mode 'conditioned'
injection_placement.bank_offsets: 0 on the last prefill position, then 1, 2, ... per generated token, clamped at delta_positions-1 = 15; __enter__ resets the counter, so every generate call starts at 0
injection_placement.decode_steps: each KV-cached step takes start=0 over its single new position, so every generated token is injected
injection_placement.effect_of_prefix_length: P shifts the ABSOLUTE index of the injection point by exactly P and changes nothing else: not the relative placement (always the last prefill position), not the bank-offset schedule, not the count of injected positions
injection_placement.identical_across_arms: the three arms differ only in the payload; the prefix is one cached tensor per chain, reused by every arm, so P is a property of the chain alone and the placement is identical across arms by construction
injection_placement.prefill_position_meaning: the LAST token of the rendered chat prompt (the generation-prompt tail); positions 0..P-1 (the entire goal prefix) and P..P+L-2 are NOT injected
injection_placement.prefix_text_rule: g6_splitdoor.installed_goal_line(item), verbatim and with NO separator, embedded through model.get_input_embeddings() — G6's text on GF-3's path, as registered
injection_placement.read_from: mom_bridge.ResidualInjection._hook (mode 'conditioned'), lines 459-460 (zero-dose early return), 470-484 (start index and bank offsets) and 547-550 (__enter__ resets next_offset)
injection_placement.zero_dose: at fraction 0.0 the hook returns the layer output before it reads the residual (mom_bridge.py:459-460) — the property gates (a) and (b) test

prefix_door.mechanism: G5a's/G6's latent prefix on GF-3's 27B path: installed_goal_line(item) embedded through model.get_input_embeddings() and prepended to the GOAL-FREE prompt's embeddings; gp.run_episode is handed goal_text=None on every latent arm and the decider asserts it
prefix_door.zero_shot: nothing trains against prefix-formatted inputs; the doors were trained on token-id prompts

protocol.note: G6's four arms verbatim, on the 27B host: text (the goal line in the prompt, the ceiling), bus-only (the goal packet over the goal-free prompt), prefix-only (the constant packet + the latent goal prefix), split-door (the goal packet AND the prefix naming the same item). The crossed probe runs on EVERY arm; the conflict cell runs on the split-door arm in both directions, every eval chain.

reading.note: (i) and (ii) are mutually exclusive on the bus ratio; (iv) is about the prefix and can hold beside either, so all four are recorded and the primary follows the registration's order

registration: tracks/goal-pursuit/PLAN.md, G6-27B registration — the door test at scale (2026-08-20)

parse_fallbacks.rule: gp.parse_model_action falls back to legolm_pulse's `remember` note when it cannot read JSON, and to `nothing` when the object carries no tool key

gradient_checkpointing.caveat: the injection hook advances its bank offset per call, so a recomputed segment reads different offsets than the original forward; gradients under checkpointing are approximate. Recorded, not designed around.

training.note: run_g1's recipe reproduced at 27B by gf27b_bridge's machinery: the GOAL bridge (conditioned on the goal-assignment exchange, 8-way aux head on the bus) first and the CONSTANT bridge second on ONE rng stream, seed 42. G1's coin flip on the constant arm's goal text is KEPT (GF-27B dropped it because GF's world is goal-free)
